summary: Ground lookout on Monument Peak, Fremont County, Wyoming, on the Wind River Indian Reservation; listed as gone on firelookout.org and firelookout.com.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on firelookout.org and on the firelookout.com page read 2026-10-10.

visit.trail_note: Peak lies on the Wind River Indian Reservation; no source read gives visiting rules. Check access with the reservation before going.

evidence.supports: peak on the Wind River Indian Reservation
page titled a fire lookout cabin
coordinates 43.66973 north, 109.19820 west; ground lookout; gone
Monument Ridge in Sublette County listed as standing

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief recorded firelookout.com as showing the lookout standing. The page read on 2026-10-10 says 'Gone.', and firelookout.org also lists it as gone. The standing reading is not supported.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two inventory listings only. No build, staffing or removal date found in the sources read. Brief access 'permission' is not stated by any source read, so it is not in facts; the visit note only says to check access. Brief agency 'Wind River Indian Reservation' is a location on the firelookout.com page, not an agency, so it is not used as one. A search also returned a different Monument Peak Lookout near Harlowton, Montana, a rental cabin; it is unrelated and was not used.
